meta.title: Happy Human – training that makes you happy
meta.description: Free, playful and intense functional training in Blomvåg, Norway, with personal trainer and sport scientist Kaja Haugen. For everyone, from beginner to super fit.

hero.title: Training that makes you happy.
hero.lead: Free, playful functional training in Blomvåg. No fitness level required – everyone's welcome.

why.title: Training should feel good – in body and mind
why.lead: No before-and-after photos, no body pressure. Just training you look forward to.

items.title: Mastery
items.text: Every exercise has an easier and a harder version, so you can always challenge yourself – at your level.

items.title: Joy of training
items.text: Playful, varied training with good vibes. You should leave happier than you arrived.

items.title: Room for everyone
items.text: From beginner to super fit. No comparing – just community.

items.title: Body and mind
items.text: Health is more than muscles. Training is about feeling good, not about how you look.

sessions.title: A playful, intense hour
sessions.lead: Strength, cardio and mobility with bodyweight and simple gear. Every exercise has an easier and a harder version.
sessions.imageLabel: Photo: circuit training in the gym hall

details.label: Format
details.text: A circuit of 8–10 stations, or cardio + mobility

details.label: Where
details.text: The gym hall at Blomvåg kindergarten – outdoors in summer

details.label: When
details.text: Posted in the Facebook group, often weekdays at 17:30 or Saturdays at 10:00

details.label: Bring
details.text: Workout clothes, shoes, water – and a friend, if you like

trainer.name: Kaja Haugen
trainer.role: Founder, personal trainer and sport scientist
trainer.bio: A personal trainer and group instructor for over seven years, with a master's in sport science from the Norwegian School of Sport Sciences. Today she works at Anti-Doping Norway. Kaja is passionate about training that does you good – body and mind.
trainer.quote: My goal is for you to feel mastery and joy in training.

items.q: Do I need to be fit?
items.a: No! Every exercise has easier and harder versions, so the class works for everyone – from beginner to super fit.
Join the Facebook group. Kaja posts new sessions there, and you just mark whether you're coming.
Yes. No babysitter? Bring the kids and we'll adapt as we go.

finalCta.title: Ready to join?
finalCta.lead: Find the next session in the group – come on your own or bring a friend. There's room for everyone.
